phase4_conclusion: All 4 PDF fixture strategies are validated and repeatable. The programmatic creation approach using Aspose.Pdf.Document() is confirmed. Critical API corrections found: AddOutput() takes FileDataSource (not FileSaveTarget), ResultContainer uses ResultCollection, no IsSuccess, Splitter does not expand format strings. All corrections must be applied to LLM code generation rules before PDF pilot can run. Generation remains blocked.
